description: Keyword search over Carragent's agents and plans, best match first. Use it to find the agent for a task in the user's words, such as 'chase late invoices' or 'confirm appointments'. Returns { results: [...] }, each with its kind (agent or plan), id, name, description and score.

lang.description: Language of the text: en, es or fr.

query.description: What the user needs, in their words.

name: search_carragent

id.description: The id, for get_agent when kind is agent.

score.description: How well it matched; higher first.

title: Search Carragent
